comments.author: Tammer
comments.body:
To obtain this, you plunder a Pirate's notes (r12 recognition and unlock in Baltic Sea) from Azores pirates which ambush north of the Azores. The notes give Viking's Treasure Chest which can drop the armour.

The Azores pirates with the map ambush only characters with certain levels. The Taiwanese wiki gives total level 55-60, Akasan's blog says 55-65. I used a level 55 alt.
